are_you_ok.title: Rare mosquito-borne virus confirmed in South Texas man
are_you_ok.summary: 79-year-old Tony Gomez spent two weeks on a ventilator after contracting St. Louis encephalitis, a rare mosquito-borne virus now confirmed in South Texas, the region running from San Antonio south to the border.

conversation_starters.title: Possible mountain lion sighted in Castroville park, officials urge caution
conversation_starters.summary: A mountain lion sighting was reported to park officials in Castroville, a small town about 25 miles west of San Antonio, on Saturday. Officials do not have confirmed information, but are urging park-goers to be cautious.
questions: Have you heard anything more about the mountain lion sighting in Castroville?
